title: No-signalling recovered (not derived) as marginal-invariance: a uniform classical+quantum constraint-vs-channel max-TV separator, with 'inference update is not influence' as an audit-DPI category-error guard

original_card.one_sentence_claim: SBT recovers (does not derive) no-signalling as a marginal-invariance / data-processing fact by formally separating "constraint" (P2 joint-feasibility cone) from "channel" (intervention-respecting causal mechanism): a remote setting leaves the local reduced/marginal state invariant (EXP-NS1 ~2e-16; classical XOR constraint box max-TV=0) while conditioning on an announced outcome changes the conditional state sharply (dist=1; signalling box TV=1), guarded by the finite TV data-processing inequality (Lean tvdist_pushforward_le) so that coarse access cannot manufacture a detectable remote marginal change.
original_card.target_known_fact: No-signalling theorem: the reduced (marginal) statistics at a spacelike-separated party B are invariant under the remote measurement-basis choice at A, while conditioning on A's announced outcome can change B's conditional state arbitrarily. Operationally: a classical XOR/one-time-pad constraint box yields strong conditional dependence but zero signalling (max-TV=0); a true channel yields maximal signalling (TV=1); Bell-nonlocal correlations are no-signalling (Eberhard-Ghirardi no-superluminal-signalling; Popescu-Rohrlich/Brunner et al. box framework; Shannon one-time-pad).
original_card.scientific_domain: Quantum foundations / relativity (operational locality) / quantum information

revised_one_sentence_claim: Conditional on a declared record lens f_B and declared boxes, SBT RE-EXPRESSES (does not derive) operational no-signalling as marginal-invariance under remote-setting variation, supplying a single uniform max-TV remote-marginal separator that classifies a declared family P(a,b|x,y) as a 'constraint' (P2 joint-feasibility carving; classical XOR/one-time-pad box max-TV=0, quantum EPR ~2.2e-16) versus a 'channel' (intervention that moves the remote marginal; signalling box max-TV=1), while conditioning sharply changes the conditional object (dist=1); the SBT-internal finite deterministic TV data-processing inequality (thm:tv-dpi, Lean tvdist_pushforward_le) is offered as a classical/deterministic 'no false positives' analogue, whereas the actual quantum no-signalling content (partial-trace/CPTP marginal invariance and the CPTP-DPI) is IMPORTED by citation (Nielsen-Chuang, Lindblad 1975) and explicitly not re-proved.
new_minimum_viable_result: A fully grounded, audit-grade demarcation note + reproducible exhibit consolidating what already exists in the papers: (i) the classical separator -- XOR constraint box b=a XOR (x AND y) gives marginal-invariant max-TV(A->B)=0 (one-time-pad), signalling box b=x gives max-TV=1, both cited to Lean lemmas marginalB_uniform_of_xor_constraint / signalling_marginalB_depends_on_x; (ii) the EXP-NS1 quantum reproduction no_signalling_dist_Z=0, no_signalling_dist_X ~2.22e-16, cond_outcome_dist_Z=1; (iii) the SBT-internal finite TV-DPI (thm:tv-dpi / tvdist_pushforward_le) presented strictly as a classical/deterministic analogue of the 'no false positives' reading, with the quantum guard attributed to the IMPORTED CPTP-DPI. The deliverable is a single uniform classical+quantum operational separator (max-TV remote-marginal test) plus an 'inference update is not influence' category-error diagnosis, conditional on a declared lens and declared boxes, explicitly labelled RECOVERY + reorganization (class A), NOT a derivation of the quantum no-signalling theorem. Honest-scope acceptance requires shipping the actual Lean sources and Python exhibits (currently absent from the corpus) so the 'Lean-certified / reproducible' claim is independently checkable.
changes_made: NARROWED claim scope: prefixed 'Conditional on a declared record lens f_B and declared boxes' and replaced 'recovers ... as a marginal-invariance fact' with 'RE-EXPRESSES (does not derive) ... as marginal-invariance', removing any reading of emergence/derivation (addresses candidates.json core_claim over-reach flagged by skeptic 2).

CLARIFIED THE GUARD MAPPING (corrected an overstatement, not added an assumption): the original one_sentence_claim read as if the finite TV-DPI 'guards' the quantum no-signalling fact. Repaired to state the finite deterministic TV-DPI is a CLASSICAL/DETERMINISTIC analogue of 'no false positives', and the genuine quantum guard is the IMPORTED CPTP-DPI (Lindblad 1975), which is a different and strictly weaker-vs-deeper statement. This is the central repairable objection raised by the referee skeptic and the math-physicist skeptic.

FLAGGED IMPORTED PHYSICS IN-LINE (no hiding): partial-trace/CPTP marginal invariance, the CPTP-DPI, and Born-rule statistics are stated in the revised claim itself as imported by citation and not re-proved, per Quantum paper lines 815-816 verified verbatim.

SPLIT the conflated objects: separated 'unconditional marginal' (the no-signalling object) from 'conditional state' (the conditioning-sensitive object), with the lens f_B declared as a free input rather than canonical (pointer-basis selection disclaimed).

CONVERTED rhetoric to a scoped, decidable classification statement: the constraint-vs-channel distinction is framed as a decidable max-TV partition of a DECLARED box family, explicitly acknowledging (opposite-world symmetry) that the same separator classifies a signalling box at max-TV=1, so the no-signalling asymmetry is supplied entirely by imported physics, not by SBT structure.

DOWNGRADED the F49 anchor: re-labelled F49 as a DEFINITIONAL normal form (LocallyExplainable := CommonSource OR InterfaceFactorization, proved iff by unfolding -- verified at thm:F49 lines 8278-8325), carrying no content about which physical correlations occupy which bucket; it CLASSIFIES, it does not predict Bell magnitudes.

ADDED a verifiability caveat: the four named Lean lemmas (tvdist_pushforward_le, marginalB_uniform_of_xor_constraint, signalling_marginalB_depends_on_x, common_source_nonlocal_correlation) and the Python exhibits (no_signalling_epr.py, no_signalling_toy.py) are ABSENT from this corpus (zero .lean / matching .py files found); the 'Lean-certified / reproducible' status is bibliographic, made a minimum-acceptance condition rather than treated as verified.
remaining_objections: DEEP PHYSICS IMPORTED, NOT DERIVED (uncurable within scope): the only fact that pins the actual world to the no-signalling side -- rho_B = Tr_A((Phi_x (x) id) rho) independent of x because a local CPTP map leaves the partial trace invariant -- is imported by citation (Quantum lines 815-816, 'We will not re-prove the full quantum DPI here'; card lemma table marks it already_in_papers=false / 'imported deep content'). SBT does no work on the only step with physical content. Caps derivability at class A.

OPPOSITE-WORLD SYMMETRY (verified): To_Notch lines 552-561 exhibit the signalling box b=x at max-TV=1 using the identical max-TV separator that gives the constraint box max-TV=0. The separator is a thermometer reporting whatever box you declare; it forbids nothing. A signalling world is representable at zero extra cost. This is the signature of a recovery/relabel, not a prediction.

TARGET USED TO DESIGN THE TOY (verified): g(x,y)=x AND y (To_Notch line 552) is hand-picked so the one-time-pad marginal is uniform/x-independent (max-TV=0) and b=x (line 555) is hand-picked to be maximally signalling (max-TV=1); the known endpoints {0,1} drove the construction.

ZERO DISCRIMINATING POWER IN THE DATA: the three matched outcomes {0, ~2.22e-16, 1} are degenerate exact-zero/exact-one extremes mandated by standard no-signalling / one-time-pad / CPTP theory, against ~8 adjustable choices. Born-rule statistics are consumed as input, so the numbers are reproductions, not predictions; no non-trivial magnitude (e.g. a Tsirelson/CHSH bound) is or can be produced.

ARTIFACTS NOT VERIFIABLE IN THIS CORPUS: no .lean files and no Python exhibit files exist under the papers tree; the named lemmas and scripts appear only as identifiers inside .tex. The reproducibility/certification claim could not be independently confirmed here.

RELATIVISTIC SIDE IS PURE RELABELLING: the light cone, spacelike separation, and Lorentz causal structure are DECLARED as a P2 cone (To_Notch line 538), not produced; no spacetime, foliation, or continuum limit. F49 is a definitional tautology with no content about physical correlations.

SBT-INTERNAL CONTENT IS ELEMENTARY: the finite deterministic TV-DPI is a one-line textbook pushforward contraction; the XOR-box marginal fact is a one-line one-time-pad observation; the proposed named 'P2-cone constraint-vs-channel separation theorem' is acknowledged elementary and still imports the CPTP fact for the quantum case.
mitigating_factors: The card is exemplary in honesty: its honest_status_note pre-concedes RECOVERY + reorganization, class A, and explicitly disclaims deriving no-signalling, the Born rule, Bell, the light cone, and pointer-basis/single-outcome selection. No skeptic raised a fatal objection (panel min survival 2, mean 2.75).

GENUINE CROSS-FACT MECHANISM REUSE: the core mechanism (audit-DPI / pushforward contraction, tvdist_pushforward_le) recurs across >=2 SBT facts -- the arrow-of-time 'no fake arrows' guard (NG_ARROW_DPI / thm:dpi_path), the currency shadow-price KL monotonicity (To_Spend_a_Stone), and the closure-deficit Pinsker bound -- so it is a reusable audit vocabulary rather than a one-off curve fit.
The single uniform classical+quantum separator does make explicit and legible that no-signalling is NOT specifically quantum (a real, if modest, conceptual contribution as bookkeeping).

score_rationale.impact: 2 - As a category-error demarcation ('inference update is not influence') with a portable diagnostic, it is mildly useful pedagogy/bookkeeping for foundations and QI audiences, but it derives no new physics, predicts no magnitude, and does not advance the no-signalling/Bell literature beyond a relabel. Low impact.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 4 - The classical XOR result, the finite TV-DPI, and EXP-NS1 are described as already implemented/certified; the only new writing is an elementary named theorem + consolidation. NOT 5 because the Lean/Python artifacts are absent from this corpus and must actually be shipped and shown to compile/reproduce for honest acceptance.
score_rationale.plausibility: 5 - Everything claimed is true: marginal invariance under local CPTP, the one-time-pad max-TV=0 fact, and the finite TV-DPI are all correct standard results. Zero risk of the claim being false; the only risk is over-selling, which the repair addresses.
score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 3 - Mixed. Against it: the toy boxes are reverse-engineered to the known {0,1} endpoints and the lens is a free, disclaimed choice. For it: the underlying mechanism (audit-DPI) is principled and genuinely reused across multiple SBT facts, and the card honestly flags every import. Net middling.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 1 - Near-zero. The data are degenerate {0, ~0, 1} extremes forced exactly by standard theory; the opposite-world test passes (a signalling world is equally representable); the separator merely reports the declared box. The framework cannot distinguish the actual no-signalling world from a hypothetical signalling one -- that asymmetry is 100% imported.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4 - The constraint-vs-channel / max-TV separator and the 'inference update is not influence' framing are crisp, operational, and immediately legible to foundations / QI / formal-methods audiences; a Lean anchor (once shipped) adds checkability. NOT 5 because the relativistic 'P2 cone' relabel and F49 framing risk being read as more than declared.
score_rationale.precision: 2 - The qualitative classification (constraint=0 vs channel>0) is sharp, but SBT produces no quantitative valuation: no predicted magnitude, no Tsirelson/CHSH bound, no detectability threshold (the Pinsker lower bound is only an unbuilt optional). Disclaimers (no Born rule, no probability valuation) cap precision.
score_rationale.robustness: 4 - The recovered facts are exact and seed-independent (the ~2.22e-16 is machine zero; the classical 0/1 are exact). The result is robust precisely because it is a recovery of theorems that cannot fail. NOT 5 only because robustness of the un-shipped Lean/Python artifacts could not be confirmed here.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 1 - The card itself concedes baseline_comparison='RECOVERY, not improvement on the physics.' The load-bearing facts (CPTP marginal invariance, CPTP-DPI) are imported; SBT adds a finite-TV inequality and a vocabulary. It does not beat the standard account (Eberhard-Ghirardi, GPT/PR-box). Disclaimers cap this.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2 - Viable only as a short methods-style demarcation note or an appendix to the Quantum paper, framed explicitly as recovery + a Lean-anchored exhibit, NOT as a standalone result. As new physics or a derivation it is unpublishable; as honest bookkeeping with shipped artifacts it is a minor note.

bin_rationale: B (foundational sanity check). This is a faithful RECOVERY of a known theorem (no-signalling) plus an honest category-error demarcation -- exactly the role of a sanity check that confirms SBT's audit vocabulary reproduces standard operational locality without crossing its disclaimers. It is NOT a quick win (A) because no new result is produced and the cited artifacts are not present to ship immediately; NOT a flagship (C) because it derives nothing and the deep physics is imported; NOT high-risk numerical (D) since the numbers are forced exact extremes; it has an element of conceptual reframing (E: 'inference update is not influence', the uniform separator) but its primary value is as a grounded consistency/demarcation check, so B over E.
priority_rationale: Low. The scientific yield is a relabel of imported physics plus an elementary inequality; discriminative power and baseline advantage are at the floor. Worth doing only as cheap, honest housekeeping (consolidate the existing exhibit, ship the Lean/Python files, correct the guard-mismatch wording), not as a research investment. Execution is cheap (days) but payoff is small.
recommended_artifact: A short 'demarcation note + reproducible exhibit' (4-6 pages or an appendix to the Quantum paper): one scoped, decidable SBT statement (P2-cone constraint-vs-channel partition via the max-TV remote-marginal separator) wrapping the SHIPPED Lean anchors (tvdist_pushforward_le; marginalB_uniform_of_xor_constraint; signalling_marginalB_depends_on_x) and the SHIPPED Python exhibits (no_signalling_epr.py, no_signalling_toy.py); one figure/table showing classical max-TV 0/1 alongside quantum ~2.22e-16/1; and an explicit IMPORTED-vs-RECOVERED disclaimer block stating that CPTP marginal invariance, the CPTP-DPI, and Born statistics are imported by citation, the finite TV-DPI is only a classical/deterministic analogue, and the light cone is declared not produced. Titled as RECOVERY + category-error demarcation, class A; never a derivation.

panel.main_objection: Faithful and honestly scoped, but recovers nothing relativistic and derives nothing quantum: the no-signalling content rests on imported partial-trace/CPTP marginal invariance; the light cone, spacelike separation, and Lorentz structure are declared, not produced; F49 is a definitional tautology. A vocabulary + an elementary inequality, not an explanation.

Load-bearing physics imported by citation, not derived; opposite-world symmetry confirmed; target endpoints used to design the toy; data carry essentially zero discriminating power against ~8 choices. Recovery + relabel, class A, as the honest_status_note concedes.

Entire load-bearing content imported; the separator is a thermometer reporting whatever box you declare; SBT pins the world to no-signalling only via imported QM, never via its own structure. Known-physics recovery + a vocabulary, near-zero new SBT-internal content of physical interest.

Import circularity plus a GUARD MISMATCH: the finite TV-DPI is advertised as guarding no-signalling, but it is a different/weaker statement than CPTP partial-trace marginal invariance and does not entail quantum no-signalling. As a derivation it is fatally circular; as the explicitly-scoped recovery the card actually claims, it survives because the card pre-concedes every point. Repairable by rewording the claim (done in this repair).
